subtitle.pt: Personagem humanoide estilizada, do blockout à texturização
subtitle.en: Stylised humanoid character, from blockout to texturing

summary.pt: Personagem humanoide com proporções estilizadas, construída para animar: topologia pensada para deformação e mapas de 4K em dois UDIMs.
summary.en: A humanoid character with stylised proportions, built to be animated: topology planned for deformation and 4K maps across two UDIMs.

en.heading: Brief and constraints
en.text: Model a humanoid character readable at silhouette level and clean enough to be rigged by someone else. That second constraint changed everything: the mesh is not the prettiest version of the model, it is the most predictable one under deformation.

en.heading: The problem
en.text: Stylised proportions break anatomical edge-flow rules. I kept the loops anatomically correct at the joints and let them go stylised only in the volumes between joints, which is where nobody deforms.
